posts.title: AI and the mental obstacles programmers face today
posts.description: AI changed how we write code, and it’s taking a mental toll on many developers. Four common fears (losing the joy of problem solving, losing fluency, being replaced, and tech debt) and how I deal with them.

posts.title: How I use AI to develop Wyvern
posts.description: AI is a colleague on my Wyvern project, not the lead. I walk through my workflow from requirements and planning to review and release, where AI helps, where it doesn’t, and why I stay responsible for everything I ship.

posts.title: Why I built Wyvern, and why I chose C++ over Rust, Zig or Golang
posts.description: From a search engine blocked in Iran in 2009 to building a new one in Austria: the story behind Wyvern, how it searches by meaning, and why I chose C++.
